sources.entry: Git Annex - File synchronization between computers, servers, external drives. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Haskell

summary.name: git-annex
summary.one_liner: git-annex is a command-line tool that manages large files with git without storing their contents in git, for syncing, backup, and archiving across drives, servers, and the cloud.
use_cases: Archiving data across many offline drives
Syncing files between computers, servers and external drives
Backing up large files with git
Downloading files to a USB drive while offline and syncing later
Tracking which drive holds which file
summary.what_it_does:
git-annex lets git track large files without putting their contents into git history, so a repository can hold file names and versions while the content lives elsewhere. It can sync, back up, and archive data both offline and online. It manages drives and servers as if they were git remotes, and records which remote holds which file content so files can be located and fetched. Checksums and encryption are used to protect data. A git-annex assistant provides an easier folder-synchronizing mode for users who do not want to use the command line.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">open source
notable: Treats external drives, servers and cloud storage as git remotes and tracks which drive holds each file
Git-annex assistant provides an easy folder synchroniser for non-command-line users
Uses a simple repository format intended to remain accessible long-term
caveats: Designed mainly for users comfortable with the git command line
Platform list (Linux, macOS, Windows) is not stated on the page; only git is named
